description: Claude Code prompts by permission mode and the transitions between modes, from OTel log events.

links.title: Claude Working Time
links.tooltip: How long Claude Code worked for each engineer, per repository and workday. That dashboard uses your browser's timezone where this one uses UTC, so a relative range such as Today covers your local day there

panels.description: The permission mode used by the most prompts in the selected time range, projects, engineers and repositories. 'Agentic' is Claude Code's default mode. Counts every prompt, including ones that made no model request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.mode END AS "Most used mode"
FROM (
  SELECT p.permission_mode AS mode, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY p.permission_mode
) m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.mode
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Most Used Mode

panels.description: The reasoning effort used by the most prompts in the selected time range, projects, engineers and repositories. Only prompts that made at least one model request count; 'N/A' means no effort was reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' WHEN '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(m.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(m.effort, 2)) END AS "Most used effort"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.effort, '') AS effort, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.effort, '')
) m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.effort
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Most Used Effort

panels.description: Percentage of prompts that ran in plan mode, out of all prompts in the selected time range, projects, engineers and repositories. Counts every prompt, including ones that made no model request, such as /plan itself.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.permission_mode = 'plan') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Plan mode share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Bypass Permissions Share

panels.description: Percentage of sessions with at least one prompt in the selected filters that also switched permission mode at least once in the time range. Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; switching with /plan is.

targets.rawSql:
-- s holds the sessions with at least one counted switch in the time range.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id), 0) AS "Sessions with a switch"
FROM ai_prompts p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.session_id
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
) s ON s.session_id = p.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Sessions With a Mode Switch

panels.description: Percentage of engineers with at least one prompt in the selected filters who sent at least one prompt in plan mode.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(e.used_plan) AS "Engineers using plan mode"
FROM (
  SELECT MAX(p.permission_mode = 'plan') AS used_plan
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)
) e

panels.title: Engineers Using Plan Mode

panels.description: Prompts, share of prompts, total cost, and cost, tokens and tool calls per prompt, for each permission mode, model (or model combination), effort, repository and engineer. Prompts that made no model request, such as local slash commands, are left out, so Share is out of the remaining prompts. Repository 'Unknown' / Project 'No repository' means the prompt ran outside a repository; 'Unmapped' means no DevLake project you can access collects that repository.

targets.rawSql:
-- r groups every prompt the panel counts on the raw columns; the labels are applied once per row.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
    -- another account with the same email.
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    p.permission_mode, p.models_used, p.effort,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens,
    SUM(p.tool_call_count) AS tool_calls
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
  GROUP BY p.repository_url, 2, p.permission_mode, p.models_used, p.effort
)
SELECT CASE r.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE r.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') AS "Model",
  CASE r.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(r.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(r.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', '')
    -- CodeCommit URLs have no owner, only v1/repos/ before the repository name.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/v1/repos/', '')
    -- Azure DevOps puts _git/ between the project and the repository.
    ELSE REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', ''), '/_git/', '/')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitHub'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitLab'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'Bitbucket'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(dev[.]azure[.]com|[^/]+[.]visualstudio[.]com)/' THEN 'Azure DevOps'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN 'AWS CodeCommit'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://source[.]developers[.]google[.]com/' THEN 'Google Cloud Source'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?codeberg[.]org/' THEN 'Codeberg'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git[.]sr[.]ht/' THEN 'SourceHut'
    -- Any other host, such as a self-hosted Gitea, is shown by its host name.
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://([^/]+).*$', '$1')
  END AS "Repo Source",
  CASE WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "Engineer",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.tokens / r.prompts AS "Tokens per prompt",
  r.tool_calls / r.prompts AS "Tool calls per prompt",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(r.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url drops one trailing / and then one .git suffix, and is lowercased, so normalize
  -- repos.url the same way.
  SELECT LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', '')) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  -- Only projects the viewer can access, so a repository shared with another project doesn't
  -- reveal its name.
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
    AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_p.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_p WHERE upm_p.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', ''))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY 1, r.repository_url IS NULL, 5, 4, 7, r.prompts DESC

panels.title: Permission Mode Breakdown

panels.description: Permission mode switches in the time range, counted as switches and distinct sessions, by from mode, to mode, trigger, and the model and effort of the session's latest prompt at the time of the switch. 'Before /plan' is a switch made with /plan, where Claude Code doesn't report the mode before it. Trigger: Shift+Tab, Plan approved (leaving Plan by approving its plan), /plan, Auto-gate denial (Auto refused an action and dropped to Agentic), Auto upsell accepted (switched to Auto from a Bash permission prompt), or No trigger reported. Startup applying the configured default mode is not counted. Model '(no prompt)' is a switch before the session's first prompt; 'N/A' means that prompt made no model request (for example /plan); Effort 'N/A' means no effort was reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.from_mode WHEN '' THEN 'Before /plan' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE m.from_mode END AS "From",
  CASE m.to_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE m.to_mode END AS "To",
  CASE WHEN pr.models_used IS NULL THEN '(no prompt)' WHEN pr.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(pr.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS "Model",
  CASE pr.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(pr.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(pr.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  CASE m.`trigger` WHEN 'shift_tab' THEN 'Shift+Tab' WHEN 'exit_plan_mode' THEN 'Plan approved' WHEN 'auto_gate_denied' THEN 'Auto-gate denial' WHEN 'plan_command' THEN '/plan' WHEN 'bash_permission_prompt_upsell' THEN 'Auto upsell accepted' WHEN '' THEN 'No trigger reported' ELSE m.`trigger` END AS "Trigger",
  COUNT(*) AS "Switches",
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
-- The prompt running when the mode changed: the session's latest prompt started at or before the change.
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p2.models_used, p2.effort
  FROM ai_prompts p2
  WHERE p2.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND p2.session_id = m.session_id AND p2.started_at <= m.changed_at
  ORDER BY p2.started_at DESC, p2.prompt_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) pr ON TRUE
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
  AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Mode Transitions

panels.description: Engineers who switched permission mode in the time range, most switches first. Switches: counted switches. Sessions with a switch: sessions with at least one. Sessions: the engineer's sessions with prompts in the range. Switches per session: Switches / Sessions. Most common transition: the from → to pair they switched most, with its count; ties go to the first alphabetically. Shift+Tab share: share of switches made with Shift+Tab. Plans approved: switches out of Plan made by approving its plan; leaving Plan with Shift+Tab isn't counted here. /plan: plan mode entered with /plan. Auto-gate denials: Auto refused an action and dropped to Agentic. No trigger reported: switches whose Claude Code version gave no trigger. Startup applying the configured default mode is not counted; switches before a session's first prompt are. Click an engineer for their sessions' modes over time.

targets.rawSql:
-- sw is every counted switch in the range whose session matches the filters.
WITH sw AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) AS user, m.session_id, m.from_mode, m.to_mode, m.`trigger`
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
),
-- ps is each engineer's sessions with prompts in the range, their teams and their name.
ps AS (
  SELECT x.user, SUM(x.sessions) AS sessions,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS teams,
    MAX(x.full_name) AS full_name
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user, p.source_connection_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
      MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
    FROM ai_prompts p
    LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
      AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
      AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) x
  JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = x.source_connection_id
  GROUP BY x.user
),
-- top is each engineer's most common transition.
top AS (
  SELECT user, transition
  FROM (
    SELECT user, CONCAT(CASE from_mode WHEN '' THEN 'Before /plan' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE from_mode END, ' → ', CASE to_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE to_mode END, ' (', COUNT(*), ')') AS transition,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, from_mode, to_mode) AS rn
    FROM sw
    GROUP BY user, from_mode, to_mode
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
-- agg is each engineer's switch counts, joined to the small ps and top sets below.
agg AS (
  SELECT user,
    COUNT(*) AS switches,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS switch_sessions,
    SUM(`trigger` = 'shift_tab') AS shift_tab,
    SUM(`trigger` = 'exit_plan_mode') AS plan_exits,
    SUM(`trigger` = 'plan_command') AS plan_command,
    SUM(`trigger` = 'auto_gate_denied') AS gate_denials,
    SUM(`trigger` = '') AS no_trigger
  FROM sw
  GROUP BY user
)
SELECT COALESCE(ps.full_name, agg.user) AS "Engineer",
  ps.teams AS "Team",
  agg.switches AS "Switches",
  agg.switch_sessions AS "Sessions with a switch",
  ps.sessions AS "Sessions",
  agg.switches / NULLIF(ps.sessions, 0) AS "Switches per session",
  top.transition AS "Most common transition",
  agg.shift_tab / agg.switches AS "Shift+Tab share",
  agg.plan_exits AS "Plans approved",
  agg.plan_command AS "/plan",
  agg.gate_denials AS "Auto-gate denials",
  agg.no_trigger AS "No trigger reported",
  agg.user AS user
FROM agg
LEFT JOIN ps ON ps.user = agg.user
LEFT JOIN top ON top.user = agg.user
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1

panels.title: Switches per Engineer

panels.description: Switches in the time range, with the mode switched from as rows and the mode switched to as columns; each cell is a switch count, darker for more. Total is the row's switches. 'Before /plan' is a switch made with /plan, where Claude Code doesn't report the mode before it. Startup applying the configured default mode is not counted. Other is any mode not listed.

targets.rawSql:
-- sw is every counted switch in the range whose session matches the filters.
WITH sw AS (
  SELECT CASE m.from_mode WHEN '' THEN 'Before /plan' WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END AS f, m.to_mode
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    -- Startup applying the configured default mode is not a switch; older clients report it with no trigger.
    AND m.`trigger` <> 'startup_reresolve'
    AND NOT (m.`trigger` = '' AND m.from_mode = 'default' AND m.to_mode = 'auto'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_prompts fp WHERE fp.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND fp.session_id = m.session_id AND fp.started_at <= m.changed_at))
)
SELECT f AS "From ↓ / To →",
  SUM(to_mode = 'default') AS "Agentic",
  SUM(to_mode = 'auto') AS "Auto",
  SUM(to_mode = 'acceptEdits') AS "Accept Edits",
  SUM(to_mode = 'plan') AS "Plan",
  SUM(to_mode = 'bypassPermissions') AS "Bypass Permissions",
  SUM(to_mode NOT IN ('default', 'auto', 'acceptEdits', 'plan', 'bypassPermissions')) AS "Other",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total"
FROM sw
GROUP BY f
ORDER BY FIELD(f, 'Agentic', 'Auto', 'Accept Edits', 'Plan', 'Bypass Permissions', 'Other', 'Before /plan')

panels.title: Mode Flow

panels.description: Each engineer's most used permission mode per UTC day: one row per engineer, one cell per day, coloured by the mode most of their prompts ran in that day. A cell is a day, not time spent working, and doesn't show how many prompts there were or how clear the lead was. Only prompts whose mode was reported count; days with none are blank. Prompts that made no model request are left out. Hover a cell for the engineer and mode. Shows the 15 engineers with the most such prompts; use the panel link 'Show every engineer' for the full list.

targets.rawSql:
-- pm is each engineer's prompts per day and observed mode; days is each UTC day from the first of them.
WITH RECURSIVE pm AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user, DATE(p.started_at) AS d, p.permission_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
    AND NOT p.permission_mode_inferred
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
-- Starting at the first observed day keeps long ranges under MySQL's recursion limit.
days AS (
  SELECT MIN(d) AS d FROM pm
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d + INTERVAL 1 DAY < $__timeTo()
),
-- dom is the mode most of the engineer's prompts ran in that day.
dom AS (
  SELECT user, d, permission_mode,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user, d ORDER BY prompts DESC, permission_mode) AS rn
  FROM pm
),
-- eng ranks engineers by observed prompts; the panel shows the top ${daily_engineers}.
eng AS (
  SELECT user, COALESCE(MAX(full_name), user) AS engineer,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(prompts) DESC, user) AS activity_rank
  FROM pm
  GROUP BY user
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(days.d) AS time, eng.engineer,
  -- A day without observed prompts is left blank.
  CASE WHEN dom.permission_mode IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE dom.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' ELSE 'Other' END END AS mode
FROM eng
CROSS JOIN days
LEFT JOIN dom ON dom.user = eng.user AND dom.d = days.d AND dom.rn = 1
WHERE eng.activity_rank <= ${daily_engineers}
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo(), engineer, NULL FROM eng WHERE eng.activity_rank <= ${daily_engineers}
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Most Used Mode by Engineer (Daily)

panels.description: Prompts in each completed week by the permission mode in effect, taken from the prompt's own tool decisions or, failing that, the latest earlier one in the session. Inferred counts prompts whose mode had to be guessed because no tool decision reported one. Prompts that made no model request are left out.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; inferred modes are counted apart from observed ones.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
m AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(p.started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(p.started_at) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    CASE WHEN p.permission_mode_inferred THEN 'Inferred'
      WHEN p.permission_mode = 'default' THEN 'Agentic'
      WHEN p.permission_mode = 'auto' THEN 'Auto'
      WHEN p.permission_mode = 'plan' THEN 'Plan'
      WHEN p.permission_mode = 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits'
      WHEN p.permission_mode = 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions'
      ELSE 'Other' END AS mode,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Auto' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Auto",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Agentic' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Agentic",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Accept Edits' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Accept Edits",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Plan' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Plan",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Bypass Permissions' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Bypass Permissions",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Other' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Other",
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.mode = 'Inferred' THEN m.prompts ELSE 0 END) AS "Inferred"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN m ON m.week = w.week
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Permission Mode Mix (Weekly)

panels.description: Tool permission decisions in each completed week (bars, left axis). Config means settings, the active permission mode or the auto-mode classifier decided without asking; Human means a person answered the permission prompt. The line is the share a person decided (right axis). Users whose clients send no logs are left out.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; decisions count on the day their prompt started.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
d AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(t.started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(t.started_at) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    SUM(t.config_accept_count) AS config_accept, SUM(t.config_reject_count) AS config_reject,
    SUM(t.user_accept_count) AS user_accept, SUM(t.user_reject_count) AS user_reject
  FROM ai_prompt_tools t
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = t.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  COALESCE(d.config_accept, 0) AS "Config accepted",
  COALESCE(d.config_reject, 0) AS "Config rejected",
  COALESCE(d.user_accept, 0) AS "Human accepted",
  COALESCE(d.user_reject, 0) AS "Human rejected",
  (d.user_accept + d.user_reject) / NULLIF(d.config_accept + d.config_reject + d.user_accept + d.user_reject, 0) AS "Human-decided share"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN d ON d.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Approval Source (Weekly)

panels.description: Average estimated cost per prompt in each completed week, by the effort level the prompt's requests reported. N/A means no request reported one. Prompts that made no model request are left out.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; prompts that made no model request are left out.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
e AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(p.started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(p.started_at) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    CASE p.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE 'N/A' END AS effort,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Low' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Low' THEN e.prompts END) AS "Low",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Medium' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Medium' THEN e.prompts END) AS "Medium",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'High' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'High' THEN e.prompts END) AS "High",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'XHigh' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'XHigh' THEN e.prompts END) AS "XHigh",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Max' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Max' THEN e.prompts END) AS "Max",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'N/A' THEN e.cost END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'N/A' THEN e.prompts END) AS "N/A"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN e ON e.week = w.week
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
